objective.text: Collect data with a survey. Show it in a tally chart and a picture graph.

explanations.title: Survey and tally chart
explanations.text: Data is information you collect. A survey asks many people one question. A tally chart records each answer with a mark.

explanations.title: Tally marks in fives
explanations.text: Each tally mark is 1 student. Four marks and a slash make a bundle of 5. Bundles help you count fast.

explanations.title: Picture graph and key
explanations.text: A picture graph uses pictures for data. The key tells you the value of one picture.

explanations.title: Half a picture
explanations.text: If one heart is 2 students, half a heart is 1 student. You can show an odd number with half a heart.

examples.text: 3 hearts with 2 students each show 6 students. The number sentence is 3 times 2 equals 6.

explanations.text: Turn a tape diagram so it stands up. It is a vertical tape diagram. Each unit has the same value. It shows data like a picture graph.

explanations.text: A scale tells the value of each square. If each square is 5 fish, the scale counts by fives.
